[ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant provided a basic sourdough bread recipe with detailed steps:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Step 1: Create Your Sourdough Starter - 1/2 cup warm water, 1/2 cup flour, mix, cover, let sit for 24-48 hours, feed every 24 hours.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Step 2: Mix the Dough - 1 cup sourdough starter, 3 cups bread flour, 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp water, mix until shaggy, rest for 20-30 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Step 3: Knead the Dough - Knead for 10-15 minutes until smooth and elastic.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Step 4: Ferment the Dough - Let it ferment for 4-6 hours until doubled in size.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Step 5: Shape and Proof the Dough - Shape into a loaf, proof for 2-4 hours until doubled.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Step 6: Bake the Bread - Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C), bake for 30-40 minutes until golden brown.
